findings.reason: the plan must land the synchronous local-call support before or with the seat migration that makes the seats local, otherwise the already-landed node ships a live breakage of facility code discovery (its production claim that only the async variant is reached is contradicted by workers.py).
findings.text: the async `triage_worker` calls `asyncio.to_thread(call_llm_structured, model=get_model("discovery-triage"))` and `score_worker` (workers.py:463) calls the same synchronous function with `get_model("discovery-score")`; the first §21 node has already pointed both seats at `local/deepseek-v4.1-flash` (pyproject.toml:396,403) and `call_llm_structured` (llm.py:2194) hands the model id straight to `litellm.completion` with no local branch, so production code-file triage and scoring fail at runtime until the plan's third node lands — the node's own evidence fragment calls this latent on the claim "the production pipeline uses the async variant", which is false for these two workers.

rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — `call_llm_structured` and `acall_llm_structured`, the two entry points into imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py, do not share one local-routing abstraction; the plan adds the local branch to the async path only and defers the synchronous one to a later node.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the plan extends owners rather than forking them: the new narrower local-model prefix set is declared beside and drawn from `_LOCAL_MODEL_PREFIXES` in imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:881 with a subset test, `_LOCAL_ENDPOINT_PREFIXES` in imas_codex/settings.py:333 is explicitly left untouched, and §14's seed list stays in the facility `discovery_roots` owner.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §21 is the only section adding interface surface (six model seats, their env vars and pyproject tables) and its own text names what they retire and merge — `language` and `vision` are retired and their consumers folded into the six function seats.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites by name and file the machinery it extends (§21 mirrors the standard-names `sn-compose`/`sn-review` seats and reuses `get_model`/`register_model_endpoints`/`get_reasoning_effort`; §14 reuses `seed_facility_roots` in imas_codex/discovery/paths/frontier.py:426 and the single `render_path_prefix_clause` in imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py:268), and the duplication it retires is named (the five hand-written `CREATE VECTOR INDEX` copies, §15).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §21 states in its own text why the existing async local helpers (`_get_local_client`, `_acompletion_local`) cannot be reused synchronously and shares their request translation as one function rather than forking it; §14 extends the existing `discover paths --root` claim rather than adding a parallel one.
